from pathlib import Path
files=['\\''subfleet/daemon.py'\\'','\\''subfleet/conversations/service.py'\\'','\\''subfleet/cli.py'\\'','\\''subfleet/client.py'\\'','\\''subfleet/hooks.py'\\'']
def symbols(text):
    tree=ast.parse(text)
    result={}
    def visit(node,prefix='\\'''\\''):
        for item in getattr(node,'\\''body'\\'',[]):
            if isinstance(item,ast.ClassDef):
                visit(item,prefix+item.name+'\\''.'\\'')
            elif isinstance(item,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                result[prefix+item.name]=ast.dump(item,include_attributes=False)
    visit(tree)
    return result
for path in files:
    old=symbols(subprocess.check_output(['\\''git'\\'','\\''show'\\'','\\''b053e3de:'\\''+path],text=True))
    release=symbols(subprocess.check_output(['\\''git'\\'','\\''show'\\'','\\''3e13ecde:'\\''+path],text=True))
    head=symbols(Path(path).read_text())
    changed=[k for k in release if release[k]"'!=old.get(k)]
    overlap=[k for k in changed if release[k]!=head.get(k)]
    print(path, '"'\\''release changed/added:'\\'',len(changed), '\\''preserved:'\\'',len(changed)-len(overlap),'\\''overlap:'\\'',overlap,flush=True)
    print('\\''  release symbols missing in HEAD:'\\'',[k for k in release if k not in head],flush=True)
old=subprocess.check_output(['\\''git'\\'','\\''show'\\'','\\''b053e3de:docs/acceptance-contract.md'\\''],text=True)
release=subprocess.check_output(['\\''git'\\'','\\''show'\\'','\\''3e13ecde:docs/acceptance-contract.md'\\''],text=True)
head=Path('\\''docs/acceptance-contract.md'\\'').read_text()
def clauses(s):
    return {line.split('\\''**'\\'')[1]:line for line in s.splitlines() if line.startswith('\\''- **C-'\\'')}
a,b,c=map(clauses,(old,release,head))
changed=[k for k in b if b[k]"'!=a.get(k)]
print('"'\\''contract release changed/added:'\\'',len(changed),'\\''preserved:'\\'',sum(b[k]==c.get(k) for k in changed),'\\''overlap:'\\'',[k for k in changed if b[k]"'!=c.get(k)],flush=True)
print('"'\\''contract clauses missing in HEAD:'\\'',[k for k in b if k not in c],flush=True)
'"
